title: Origin story: Ironquill
description: Ironquill was a battlefield scribe who wrote with a quill of cold iron, recording every battle he witnessed without favor or fear. When a warlord ordered him to falsify a defeat, Ironquill refused — and the quill drank the warlord's lie and wrote the truth in fire across the sky. He writes still, and his chronicles cannot be altered.

title: Ability profile: Ironquill
description: Ranked abilities: Chronicling — rank 100/100; Integrity — rank 100/100; Memory — rank 97/100; Courage — rank 95/100; Speed of hand — rank 94/100.

title: Power ranking: Ironquill
description: Powers: His iron quill writes only truth; His records cannot be burned, torn, or altered; He remembers every battle ever fought.

title: Stamina feats: Ironquill
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Wrote through a siege, by siege-light; Stands unmoved before warlords.

title: Crossover notes: Ironquill
description: Ironquill crosses naturally with: records, war-history, the written oath.

title: Design notes: Ironquill
description: The record as law; truth with an iron nib.

description: This record documents the boundless generator for Ironquill's database.
